select * from (
select 'root' rid, 'n/a' parid, 'root' g, -1 lvl
union
select distinct global_region rid, 'root' parid, 'global_region' g, 0 lvl from regions
union
select distinct region rid, global_region parid, 'region' g, 1 lvl  from regions
union
select distinct country rid, region parrid, 'country' g, 2 lvl from regions
) v order by lvl
